effects.treatment: Probiotic fermented milk (kefir) enriched with Lactobacillus casei, Lactobacillus acidophilus and Bifidobacterium lactis
effects.control: Conventional fermented milk (dough), designated placebo, containing Streptococcus thermophiles and Lactobacillus bulgaricus
evidence: Clinical trial number of this study was IRCT201307092017N14.
The eligible participants were randomly assigned to intervention or placebo groups based on random block procedure produced by Random Allocation Software (RAS).

During the eight weeks of intervention, patients in the intervention group received 600ml fermented milk (kefir) containing probiotics twice a day (in lunch and dinner), and placebo group received 600 ml conventional fermented milk(dough) twice daily(with lunch and dinner).

limitations: Sample sizes are taken from the Table 4 headers (30 per group). The narrative mentions removal of glucose outliers without specifying their number or whether this affected endpoint sample sizes.
